verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an npm library you instantiate inside your own app, so it runs wherever you deploy. The docs state it requires a database you configure yourself (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and more), with automatic migrations. Community users independently confirm all auth data lives in their own database with no tie to a DB provider, that they own all the data, and that adding a user field is just a new Postgres column. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of deployment topology or data-residency guarantees (e.g., a stated commitment that no vendor cloud is involved).
